item.description: Showroom's BHM season closes with a celebration of young Black creativity and community. Good Burger (1997) is a comedy about two goofy high-school friends who take summer jobs at a local burger joint and try save it from being taken over by a chain.

item.description: Written entirely in rhyme, The Hypochondriac is Roger McGough’s hilarious take on Moliere’s 17th century comic satire of the medical profession. Presented by Sheffield University Drama Society.
